description: Aggregate sentiment for one trading day's latest minute: up/down/flat, limit-up/down, gt3/lt3 breadth, divergence index + label, MA20/50/200 breadth, 52w new highs/lows. Omit `trade_date` for today realtime. Also a `leverage` block (融资融券): judge by `exchanges.financing_net_buy_cny`, never gross `financing_buy_cny`; `structure.avg_maintenance_ratio` below 1.3 = forced-liquidation line. **The leverage block is T+1 — not the same day as the rest** — and each sub-block has its own `as_of`. `leverage` null = unavailable. Also a `turnover` block (current_turnover / predicted_total / delta_vs_yesterday, same numbers as `sentiment_turnover`'s header) — no second call needed for 成交额. `turnover.volume_trend` = `expanding` (放量) / `contracting` (缩量) / `flat` vs the previous two sessions at the same minute (`vs_prev_2d_ratio`, per-day `prev_sessions[]`); read it instead of comparing against yesterday's full-day total.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

scope.description: Universe filter: all_a | all_a_ex_st (default, ex-ST + ex-newly-listed) | st_only | main_board | star_market | chinext | bse. The four boards sum exactly to all_a_ex_st.

trade_date.description: Trade date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for today realtime

name: sentiment_overview
